annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: × Labelled diagram is missing (mandatory in heights and distances)
annotatedSteps.correctedWorking: Draw a vertical line segment AC with tower AB = h and pole BC = 6 m on top. Mark point P on the ground at distance AP = x from foot A. Join PB (angle of elevation/depression 45°) and PC (angle of elevation 60°).

annotatedSteps.studentWork:
Let AB = h m be the height of the tower and BC = 6 m the pole, and let the distance of P from the foot A of the tower be x m.
Angle of depression of P from B = 45° ⇒ ∠BPA = 45°.
In △BAP: tan 45° = AB/AP = h/x ⇒ 1 = h/x ⇒ h = x …(1)
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: ✓ Correctly related angle of depression to angle of elevation and established h = x
✓ Correctly formed equation for the total height

= 3 × 2.73 = 8.19
